verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a dedicated mobile app for responding to incidents, viewing account objects and managing settings on the go (pagerduty-docs-5). Community users confirm they get notified through the app and use it to ack pages (pagerduty-comm-1, pagerduty-comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that escalate and resolve actions are available in the mobile app (acknowledge/resolve is documented only generically in pagerduty-docs-21), and hands-on corroboration of escalating or resolving from the phone.
